conversation_format.description: Format for injecting conversation history into prompts. Preserves context while managing token budget.

guidelines.guideline: Include only the last 3-5 turns to stay within token budget
Truncate long messages to ~500 characters with "..." suffix
Preserve tool call context when relevant to current query
Include thinking steps summary if user asked follow-up
Omit system messages and metadata from history

conversation_context.turn: How do I check disk space?
Use `df -h` to see disk usage in human-readable format.
